positions.name: CalibrationAuthorityByReference
positions.frame: How is instrument calibration authority established and recorded through appeal to a verification standard?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same directional move: asserting a settled calibration state by deferring to the June reference plates as the ranked benchmark that legitimates it. src-1 carries Quill's reported speech in native technical vocabulary — frequency value, observing band, verification chain — while src-2 compresses the same claim into a flat decision-log entry. The shared read is calibration authority constituted through benchmark verification and then recorded as load-bearing fact; the tension between performed expertise (src-1) and instrumental summary (src-2) is the same stance at two registers, not a disagreement.
